OBJECT_PROP.label: Rigid, Hinged or Ballistic Object / Prop

MONSTER_MULTI_LIMB_KAIJU.label: Monster, Multi-Limbed Creature or Colossal Kaiju

classical_12_principles.name: Squash & Stretch (Isochoric Volume Preservation)
classical_12_principles.rule: Elongate along velocity vector at peak speed and flatten perpendicular on impact while strictly conserving total volume (`Sx * Sy * Sz = 1.0`); scale amplitude by material softness (`steel=1.02`, `flesh=1.18`, `rubber=1.45`).

classical_12_principles.name: Anticipation (Reverse Counter-Impulse)
classical_12_principles.rule: Precede every major force action (jump, strike, sprint, throw) with a readable counter-movement along the opposite vector (`2–5` frames) to load elastic potential energy and cue viewer gaze.

classical_12_principles.name: Staging & Solid Black Silhouette Test
classical_12_principles.rule: Pose key storytelling extremes so limbs, props, and head remain legible even when filled solid `#000000` against white—never hide hands/weapons inside torso overlap.

classical_12_principles.name: Pose-to-Pose Keying + Straight-Ahead Overlap
classical_12_principles.rule: Block primary narrative timing Pose-to-Pose (`Keys -> Extremes -> Breakdowns`), then layer fluid Straight-Ahead simulation on fire, cloth, hair, tails, and tentacles.

classical_12_principles.name: Follow-Through & Phase-Lagged Overlapping Action
classical_12_principles.rule: Nothing stops all at once: pelvis/thorax leads, upper limb follows (`+2f`), forearm/paw follows (`+4f`), and tail/cape/hair settles last (`+5..8f`) with damped overshoot.

classical_12_principles.name: Slow-In & Slow-Out (Non-Linear Spacing)
classical_12_principles.rule: Cluster in-betweens tightly near extremes to cushion acceleration/deceleration and open wide spacing across the fast midpoint—never use robotic linear interpolation on organic joints.

classical_12_principles.name: Natural Pendulum & Spline Arcs
classical_12_principles.rule: Because limbs rotate around ball/hinge sockets, wrists, paws, wingtips, and heads must sweep smooth circular/parabolic splines rather than sawtooth straight lines.

classical_12_principles.name: Supporting Secondary Action
classical_12_principles.rule: Enrich the main action with micro-behaviors (ear pin, breath heave, finger grip, brow tension) timed on holds/settles so they never compete with the primary apex.

classical_12_principles.name: Timing, Spacing & Froude Scale-Mass Cadence
classical_12_principles.rule: Frame count encodes physical mass and emotional intent: `3–4f` snappy light flicks, `8–12f` human strikes, `24–42f` colossal Kaiju stomps governed by Froude scaling.

classical_12_principles.name: Controlled Perceptual Exaggeration
classical_12_principles.rule: Push line-of-action curvature, impact compression, and apex hang-time just far enough to clarify physical force and emotional truth without breaking world believability.

classical_12_principles.name: Solid Volumetric Drawing & Weight Balance
classical_12_principles.rule: Construct forms as 3D cylinders, spheres, and wedges in perspective; avoid symmetrical 'twinning' (both arms/legs doing identical mirrored poses simultaneously).

classical_12_principles.name: Appeal, Rhythm & Straight-Against-Curve Contrast
classical_12_principles.rule: Juxtapose taut straight lines on the stretched tension side against rhythmic curves on the compressed fleshy side for unmistakable kinetic energy.
